$comment: Per-class prompt fragments only. The shared style suffix, the negative cues, styleVersion, palette and triBudgets live in data/base/style.json (single source of truth, read by tools/assets/common.py).
concept_camera: single object centered in frame, three-quarter front view, soft even light from the upper left, plain flat neutral background, full object visible with margin
mesh_suffix: stylized low-poly game asset, crisp flat-shaded facets, chunky readable shapes, flat colors, clean silhouette, no fine detail
style_ref_note: Match the art style of the attached reference image (crisp faceted flat-shaded low-poly look, chunky shapes, warm earthy palette), but depict only the subject described here, not the scene in the reference.
unit_pose: single character, full body visible from head to feet, relaxed standing pose, arms slightly away from the body, feet shoulder width apart, never an A-pose or a T-pose
vfx_suffix: on a pure black background, centered, glowing, soft falloff, no text
sfx_template: {subject}, dry, no reverb, close perspective, clean game sound effect
music_template: {subject}, instrumental, tribal percussion with a warm hand-played wooden flute, loop friendly, no vocals
